summary: MT-027 Asset Vault™ + MT-028 Manufacturing Economics™ fully validated. 24/24 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend Founder workflows verified end-to-end on live preview URL: upload dialog + grid, detail dialog (Mark Protected → replacement_rule updated to 'Never recreate...'), download link fires real browser download event with correct filename, new-version upload increments to v2 with both v1/v2 in version history AND original v1 file still served (not overwritten), type filter + free-text search both correctly narrow results. Manufacturing Economics page renders all summary stats (avg cost $0.06, avg margin 92.2%, reuse savings $4.30), AI cost dashboard, credit-consumption tiered list, First Dollar Mode™ recommendations with real margins (94.5% top), and 60-row economics table; PDF/CSV export endpoints both return application/pdf and text/csv with attachment Content-Disposition; $14.99 Book math verified ($0.73 processing fee, $14.16 profit, 94.5% margin). Reuse lookup finds the uploaded Founder Cover for its product_family and returns found=false for unknown families. Regression check confirmed products/{id}/pipeline still responds and MT-025 flow intact.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for DialogContent — accessibility nit; add DialogDescription to Upload and Detail dialogs. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional a11y: add <DialogDescription> to vault-upload-dialog and vault-detail-dialog to silence Radix warnings.

Optional cleanup: TEST_ prefixed vault asset (AV-00003 'TEST_ UI Founder Cover' with v2) plus a founder-cover uploaded via API remain in Mongo. Ticket note said 'assets/products you create are fine to leave' — no action required.
critical_code_review_comments: vault.py create_asset uses count_documents({}) to build asset_code AV-#####; this is fine for single-writer flows but can collide under concurrent uploads. Not a bug today, but consider a Mongo counter document or sequential atomic increment if concurrency grows.

vault.add_version appends {'version':n,'file':new,'previous_file':old} to version_history and mutates top-level file/version — correct 'new version never overwrites' behavior. Verified: the original PNG at .../vault-<oldid>.png still returns 200 after v2 was uploaded.

vault.find_reusable ORs source∈REUSABLE with approval_status∈REUSABLE — matches the ticket's Founder Imported/Protected/Approved reuse rule. SOURCE_RANK sort is deterministic; tie-break by version is sensible.
routers/vault.py:serve accepts arbitrary fname; path traversal is blocked via '/' and '..' rejection. Good.

economics.py rendering_cost hard-coded to 0.0 as ticket requires; per-type profile (Book 9,1,0,1) yields ~$0.09 for text + $0.04 image if cover_has_hero_art else 0 image. Stripe fees 2.9%+$0.30 verified against $14.99 Book.

economics.overview reads all products (limit=500) and computes rows sequentially — O(N) mongo find calls (cost_meter + reused-asset count-per-product). For >500 products this becomes slow; consider a single aggregation. Non-blocking for current scale.
MT-028 exports use in-memory csv/pdf generation. to_pdf sanitize() strips ™ correctly with 'latin-1 replace' — no crash on unicode.
AssetVault.js DetailDialog: 'Founder Approved' and 'Protected Master' buttons issue PATCH — verified UI reflects updated source and replacement_rule in-place via onChange(r.data).
AssetVault.js new-version input is a hidden <input type=file> — Playwright had to target with locator inside dialog; testers should use set_input_files on the hidden input (as ticket noted).

ManufacturingEconomics.js dl() uses window.open which triggers new-tab download — verified both open the export endpoint and the backend replies with attachment headers. If a stricter same-tab download is preferred, an <a href download> could be used, but window.open works reliably with attachment CD.
